scope: Independent source/design review against frozen D1 parent; no production pilot launched by reviewer. Focused tests use separate synthetic test protocols and do not increment pilot n.

issues_resolved: New config fields were initially omitted from the generic manifest serializer; serialization/resume checks now include them.
Fixed8-new-games chunks initially split global checkpoints after odd-prefix recovery; boundary sizing added.
Boundary sizing initially trusted a stale manifest count; complete on-disk game count now drives sizing and stale-manifest/torn-metadata regression covers it.
Preregistered paired board-winner deltas and supplemental equal-direction summaries were initially missing; now implemented.
Validator now surfaces persisted rule fault and manifest status;1800-second warning is emitted.
Independent seed checker now excludes exact current pilot output on rerun and explicitly requires all8 historical inventories.

reviewer_focused_test_run.earlier_environment_probe: Default Python lacked pytest; retried using the existing audit virtual environment. No package installation or code changes were needed.

remaining_launch_gates: Final aggregate387-test suite must finish successfully against this frozen source/measurement script; parent reported it running at review time.
Freeze preregistration, full plan, source/runtime/entry/measurement locks and verify their GitHub remote commit/tree before the first production game.
Complete the parent historical-byte-preservation audit and retain original worktrees read-only.
remaining_limits: Code review and replay consistency are not an independent implementation of all Go rules or a formal proof.
The combinatorial check assumes correct state counters/history and does not validate synthetic arbitrary-history fixtures as reachable game states.
Seed-hash nonoverlap does not establish statistical independence; paired arms intentionally reuse initial streams and may consume them differently.
Resource ceiling is checked between measured chunks, not a per-game timeout or hard memory cap; use the same complete evidence directory across the run.
Global checkpoint sizing assumes one writer; the child lock/preflight reject a conflicting or corrupt run rather than authorizing concurrent production writers.
Pilot outcomes remain descriptive, excluded from any future formal sample; no behavioral expansion or7x7 GO follows from48 games.
Six production-game regenerations and independent final arithmetic/terminal-area audit remain post-pilot requirements.
